extensionDescription.message: Translates the GitHub UI locally using bundled language dictionaries.

translationDisabledStatus.message: OFF: Show the original English UI

unsupportedBrowserLanguageStatus.message: Your browser's language has no dictionary, so nothing is translated. Choose a language to translate.

globalHeaderTranslationToggleLabel.message: Enable or disable global header translation

globalHeaderTranslationWarning.message: If the global search stops opening (e.g. right after the browser starts), turn this off.

showOriginalToggleLabel.message: Enable or disable showing the original English text on hover

showOriginalHint.message: Hover over translated text to see the original English. Useful when suggesting a better translation.

languageListLoadError.message: Unable to load the language list

altClickEditToggleLabel.message: Enable or disable editing translations with Alt+click

altClickEditHint.message: Alt+click (Option+click on Mac) translated text to change its translation or suggest an improvement.

editorHint.message: Saving reloads this tab. Other open GitHub tabs show the change after you reload them. Your translation is saved only on this device. To manage all of your translations, open the extension options page.

issueTooLongError.message: The suggestion is too long to open on GitHub. Select fewer strings.

issueTooManyError.message: You can suggest up to $MAX$ strings at once.

userDictErrorCodeText.message: Keep the text inside … the same as the original. The page does not translate code.

userDictErrorCycle.message: This translation would loop with another of your translations (A → B → A), so neither would be used. Choose a different translation.

userDictErrorCycleOnReset.message: Resetting this item would make it loop with another of your translations, so that translation would no longer be used. Change that translation first.

unsavedEditHidden.message: Your translation for “$SOURCE$” has not been saved. Show that item, fix or reset it, and try again.

userDictErrorTags.message: Keep the same tags (such as …) in the same order as the original text.

userDictErrorTagPosition.message: Text can’t go where the original has none (at the start, at the end, or between tags). Reword the translation so those positions stay empty.

userDictSaveError.message: Could not save your translation. The browser storage may be full. Your input has been kept.

userDictionaryDescription.message: Change the bundled translations for your browser only. Your translations are saved on this device and take precedence over the bundled dictionary. Leave a field empty to use the bundled translation.

bundledChangedNote.message: The bundled translation has changed since you edited it.

showingFirstRows.message: Showing the first $SHOWN$ of $TOTAL$ strings. Search to narrow the list.

savedStatus.message: Saved. Reload open GitHub tabs to apply the change.

resetAllConfirm.message: Reset all of your translations for $LANGUAGE$? This cannot be undone.

backupNote.message: Export saves your translations for all languages as a JSON file. Importing merges the file into your current translations.

importError.message: This file could not be imported.
